author: esyfilms
title_or_caption: Cooking Maniac’s Jjapaghetti - I’ll be creating every(if possible) jjapaghettic recipe hack and this episode we’re cooking jjapaghetti inspired by “Culinary Class Wars” contestant, Cooking Mania, Chef Yoon Nam-no. This version is bold, spicy, and unforgettable — featuring a chili oil sauce that transforms instant jjapaghetti into a restaurant-worthy dish. 📍Ingredients: • 1 pack of jjapaghetti (noodles, sauce powder, and flakes) • 2 green chili peppers • 1.5 tbsp gochugaru (Korean red chili flakes) • Pinch of salt • 3 tbsp olive oil (divided) • ½ tsp Sichuan peppercorns Instructions:  1. Slice the chili peppers.  2. In a bowl, mix together 1.5 tbsp gochugaru, a pinch of salt, 1 tbsp olive oil, and the jjapaghetti flakes.  3. In a separate pan, heat 2 tbsp olive oil with ½ tsp Sichuan peppercorns until fragrant. Remove the peppercorns and immediately pour the hot oil over the chili mixture. Stir well to combine.  4. In a pot, bring 600ml of water to a boil and cook the noodles until about 70–80% done. Reserve the cooking water.  5. Add the jjapaghetti sauce powder to the noodles and cook until some water evaporates.  6. Mix in the chili oil sauce and let it simmer until flavors combine.  7. Serve hot and enjoy the genius kick of Chef Yoon Nam-no’s jjapaghetti! This jjapaghetti is bold, spicy, and packed with umami. The chili oil brings depth while the classic sauce ties it all together — a true instant noodle upgrade. - #jjapaghetti #koreanrecipes #spicynoodles #esyfilms #sgfoodie  | TikTok
